notes.supports: Revised fossil stems have thick cortex and scale insertions; putative petiole/root base structures discussed. Boss shape is simplified interpretation, no claim to exact anatomical mapping.

claim_scope: Short upright single fossil fern stem fragment, cortex-dominated exterior and irregular raised attachment bosses. Volumetric integrated relief, restrained cut face with thick cortex and small plain core. No guessed crown, multi-stem interior, root mantle or growth-ring claim. Simplified specimen-inspired form.
